name: v1_adaptive_support
description: First-round GRAPE bandwidth grid with support-based filtering for signal bandwidths.
notes: The signal bandwidth grid is filtered per (S,R) before CV.
Eligibility uses 5-fold training support at held-out t values: q05_support_obs >= support_safety_factor * (p0 + 2*R*S_total).
Variance bandwidth candidates are not filtered by parameter count because the variance smoother is scalar.
